title: Influence Bound for Critical Tribes
statement: For positive integers $w$ and any nonnegative integer $k$, let $s$ be the largest integer at most $2^{w+2}$ such that $1-(1-2^{-w})^s\le 1/2$. Consider the Boolean function on $sw$ sign coordinates formed by partitioning the coordinates into $s$ blocks of width $w$, assigning each block the value $-1$ exactly when all its coordinates are $-1$ (and $1$ otherwise), and assigning the full input the value $1$ exactly when every block value is $1$ (and $-1$ otherwise). For every coalition $J$ of at most $k$ coordinates, its influence toward $1$—the fraction of inputs from which it can attain $1$ minus the fraction already having value $1$—is at most $k2^{-w}$.
